CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    Donor,
    COUNT(*) AS contribution_count,
    SUM("Amount") AS donor_total
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY Donor
),
multi_donors AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(donor_total) AS multi_donor_total,
    COUNT(*) AS multi_donor_count
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE contribution_count > 1
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("Amount") AS total_collected
  FROM donations
)
SELECT
  (multi_donors.multi_donor_total / NULLIF(total_stats.total_collected, 0)) * 100 AS percent,
  multi_donors.multi_donor_count
FROM multi_donors, total_stats;
```
